Web-drama “Kash” on iflix
2018-04-20T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/1971-liberation-war-articles/web-drama-kash-iflix-1564810

Telecom operator Airtel has partnered with streaming service iflix to launch an original web-drama titled “Kash”, according to a press release.

The 50-minute thriller has been produced by Film Noir, who gained popularity through the Projonmo Talkies short film project, and directed by Syed Ahmed Shawki. It revolves around a sales officer at a mobile banking company who tries to run away with the people's money. It stars Shamol Mawla and Parsa Evana in the central roles, among others.

This is the second collaboration between Airtel and iflix, who came together to release “Madventure” on Valentine's Day. The two companies also have plans to continue working together to produce entertainment content for viewers.
